5c4ff737523066bf4f97e1a19613189aa290a25b.summary: Malwarebytes reports Magecart-linked credit card skimmers hosted on Heroku, a container-based platform-as-a-service owned by Salesforce. The skimmers are injected into compromised shopping sites, overlay a fake payment iframe, and send stolen card data back in encoded form. The report says the abusive instances were reported to Heroku and taken down.
